gallery.title: 2026 International Treehouse Design Competition · Gallery
gallery.subtitle: Explore treehouse design visions from around the world — each entry celebrates nature, sustainability, and imagination.
gallery.voteRulesItem1: 10 votes per person: Each visitor has 10 votes to cast for 10 different treehouse entries. Votes cannot be changed after submission.
gallery.voteRulesItem2: Fairness policy: To protect participating young designers, this system includes abnormal voting detection.
gallery.voteRulesItem3: Violations: Automated bots, repeatedly clearing device records, or other improper vote manipulation are prohibited. Taiwan Treehouse Association may deduct abnormal votes without prior notice if detected by the system or manual review.
gallery.voteRulesItem4: Dream Guardians special note: Every entry carries a child's heartfelt effort. Some highly creative works were not drawn on the official template, yet the competition has chosen to showcase them in the gallery for popular voting. To preserve fairness, these entries will not advance to the expert final round. Every vote you cast is warm encouragement for the young creators!
